requirements.details: The country guide lists a final GPA minimum between 3.0 and 3.2, depending on the subject. Meet one of the listed AP, high school honours or college-level routes in addition to this GPA. The guide does not assign a precise GPA within the range to each named degree.

requirements.label: US diploma · honours or college classes
requirements.details: The alternatives listed alongside AP are two high school honors classes with B grades or two college-level classes with B grades. These are course grades.

requirements.label: English proficiency · TOEFL iBT at a test centre
requirements.details: The older scale requires 93 overall: reading 18, listening 17, speaking 20 and writing 17. The newer scale requires 4.5 overall and in each component. The page labels tests before 20 January 2026 and after 21 January 2026 separately. Confirm which scale applies to a test taken on a boundary date.

requirements.label: English proficiency · Pearson and Trinity

requirements.label: English proficiency · Cambridge alternatives
requirements.details: For these courses, B2 First requires A. C1 Advanced and C2 Proficiency require C. All three require at least 162 in each component.

requirements.label: English proficiency · IB English

requirements.label: Oxford ELLT and university pre-sessional English
requirements.details: Oxford ELLT Global or Digital requires 7 overall and at least 5 for each component. The university’s pre-sessional report requires a merit of 60% overall with at least 40% in every component.
